items.title: Jack DeJohnette interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 7, 2025
items.q: my wife and my assistant Joan Clancy spent quite a lot of time organizing for me

ctx.x: Do you save — let me rephrase, I’m sort of surrounded here by a number of your LPs and CDs and I’m wondering if you have a personal collection of Jack DeJohnette recordings? Do you save everything that you do?

Yeah as a matter of fact I have an archive, my wife and my assistant Joan Clancy spent quite a lot of time organizing for me. But you know I recorded in different formats: cassettes, DATs, reel-to-reel. Anyway you were going to ask me about favorite albums?
Yeah. I wondered if someone tried to pin you down about the recordings that you’re most proud of, is there a short list?
